vendor/ai.js is kenrick95's Connect Four AI, transcribed from TypeScript
to a classic script (the GifOS runtime drops type=module). Do not "improve"
the search — the computer is the one that shipped with c4.

upstream: https://github.com/kenrick95/c4
commit:   4e5a7768edeb373c95a5bf684271f109062c8e8a
date:     2026-08-12
license:  MIT (COPYING-c4.txt)

Pinned files transcribed:
  core/src/player/player-ai.ts   → vendor/ai.js (minimax + alpha-beta, depth 4)
  core/src/utils.ts              → clone / choose / getMockPlayerAction in board.js
  core/src/board/base.ts         → board.js (6×7, drop, four in a line)

NOT copied:
  browser/                       — Vite + type=module UI; rewritten for GifOS
  server/                        — their game server; we have no game server
  core/src/game/game-online/*    — same reason

The MIT notice travels INSIDE the GIF as COPYING-c4.txt as well as here.
